# Neliti

> Neliti is a free, open-access academic publishing platform that liberates knowledge by aggregating institutional repositories, journals, and conferences globally.

Neliti serves as a comprehensive hub for academic discovery and institutional publishing across 1500+ repositories, 3600+ journals, and 89+ conferences spanning Indonesia, India, Turkey, and other regions worldwide. The platform enables institutions to create and manage their own repositories, journals, and conferences while providing researchers with unified access to multidisciplinary academic content.

## Core Discovery

- [Repositories](https://www.neliti.com/repositories): Search 1534+ institutional repositories across Indonesia, US, India, Turkey
- [Journals](https://www.neliti.com/journals): Directory of 3628 academic journals with multidisciplinary open-access search
- [Conferences](https://www.neliti.com/conferences): Search 89 academic conferences across multiple disciplines on Neliti platform

## Getting Started

- [Create](https://www.neliti.com/create): Getting started guide for creating repositories, journals, conferences on Neliti
- [Migrate](https://www.neliti.com/migrate): Migration guide for OJS, EPrints, DSpace, Digital Commons to Neliti platform

## Publishing Services

- [DOI Registration](https://www.neliti.com/doi-registration): DOI registration service via Crossref partner with Similarity Check pricing
